geometryBasis: Every complete current native footprint of84 structures in the contiguous former-base airport/campus plus actual mapped control-tower point. No extrusion of the three membership parcels, no missing-building shortcut or arbitrary campus rotation. Source/closeup preserve all native controls and current spatial gaps. Skyline uses individually bounded complete-volume proxies; detailed wall/roof/current conservation and unobserved tower form are original estimates.
sectionBasis: Original4096m129x129/16641-height field and25 raw tiles frozen before every floor/main section. Each floor is the independently sampled12m outward approach of its native longest edge; no later foundation/floor/roof/field fitting. Approximate13.2m large-hangar eaves/9.2m smaller hangars/4.5-6.5m one-level support buildings/4.8m tanks, low2.5m hangar gables/1.5m small gables. Tower24m stem/27.5m cab glass/28.4m roof/30.4m antenna are original unphotographed estimates. Coarse source field does not prove classification, exact contact or thresholds.

tower.sectionStatus: Actual native aircraft-control point and operator-confirmed tower, footprint/height/cab form original estimates; not photograph-observed or measured.

limits: The accepted1982USAF aerial shows the parade-ground area and one major hangar only. Current84-building inventory is independently mapped; not every present roof, building, operator or tower appearance is photograph-observed. Hidden/current architectural sections, openings, materials and tower form are original bounded estimates.

Source/closeup retain every native whole perimeter and ground position. Skyline uses individual oriented rectangular full-volume proxies for support buildings and simplified tank/hangar/tower roofs. Some small wing recesses fill only at this distant level, within predeclared35m maximum plan envelope error. No source parcel extrusion or lost buildings.

Base-wide runway/taxiway/apron/landscaping, display aircraft, detached outdoor museum, later prison and detached historical housing annexes are outside this architectural model. No interior or historic1982 snapshot claim.

Current coarse unclassified DEM and per-building approach grades do not establish exact threshold/ground contact or precise floor levels. Original field, native frame, chosen floors and main sections remain unchanged after authoring.
